commands.summary: Eight focused pre-remediation security regressions reproduced against 9ac9df1.

findings: active work plus profile/path allowed mutation without an operator lease
lease scopes and paths were not enforced at action time
repair path could bypass lease and approval
caller receipt_verified flag could stand in for frozen proof
receipt approval_class was editable after signing
approval request output accepted arbitrary filesystem paths
revocation incremented protected epoch without operator proof
same-principal HMAC key replacement was reported as protected
